description: Search/list datasets on Poland's national open data portal (dane.gov.pl). Returns a JSON:API list of datasets with id, title, notes, slug, institution and resource count. Content is mostly Polish; q accepts Polish or English. Use the returned dataset id with dataset_details / list_resources.

lang.description: Language hint "en" or "pl"; only some portal fields are translated.

name: search_datasets
title: Search Datasets
